name: SystemOutput
description: writes the given string to the output stream.

params.name: obj
params.description:
Any kind of object. Lucee will serialize all complex objects passed in to a string.

If you pass a string you can include `<print-stack-trace>`, which Lucee will replace with a stacktrace of the current position.

params.name: addNewLine
params.description: Whether or not to add a newline

params.name: doErrorStream
params.description: Which stream the output should go to: choose between 'Output stream' and 'Error stream.' If true, the output will go to the error stream.
